title: alyssum campestre subsp. collinum
intro: Alyssum campestre subsp. collinum, commonly known as Mountain Alyssum, is a perennial plant species in the family Brassicaceae. This plant is valued for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and reduce stress. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Alyssum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including isothiocyanates, which have been shown to exhibit anti-cancer and anti-bacterial properties. Additionally, the plant's essential oil has been found to contain compounds such as limonene and beta-pinene, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
